paragraphs.text: When they cast their eyes toward the sepulchre.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Into the cave out of which the sepulchre was cut.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Christ himself appears to Mary Magdalene to reprove the disciple's incredulity.
paragraphs.anchor: Now when Jesus was risen early

paragraphs.text: Christ appears to two other disciples and at length to the eleven.
paragraphs.anchor: After that he appeared in another

paragraphs.text: The evangelist did not consider the chronological sequence of events, but rather what took place, which he divided into three parts: The first shows how he appeared to the women, the second to his disciples, the third to his apostles, and therefore he says "finally".
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven

paragraphs.text: The apostles are appointed, and their office is limited to them, which is to preach that which they heard from him, and to minister the sacraments which Christ has instituted, having in addition to this the power to do miracles.
Not to the Jews only, nor in Judea only, but to all men and everywhere: and so must all the apostles do.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Strange tongues, ones which they did not know before.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Christ, having accomplished his office on earth, ascends into heaven, from where (the doctrine of his apostles being confirmed with signs) he will govern his Church, until the world's end.
paragraphs.anchor: So then after the Lord had

paragraphs.text: That is, the doctrine: therefore doctrine must go before and signs must follow after.
paragraphs.label: f
